_doc: T-0419. The band the re-centred South Water corridor opens, and what branch A would cost the plat grid. Written by tools/measure_corridor_strip.py --write-baseline; the fork is the owner's and this file only pins the figures it is asked about.
_note: T-1191, 2026-09-19: KINZIE STREET JOINS THIS TABLE, and no figure already in it moved. The corridor layer reached the north bank that day, so `control_offsets` could see Kinzie's committed control at `kinzie_canal` for the first time and returned a 2.91 m re-centring — the same derivation south_water has carried since T-0009, asked of a street it had never been asked of. The band it opens is 4,132.8 m2 wide and EMPTY: no lot and no structure stands in either half of it, abandoned or claimed, which is why this is a widening of the question rather than a change of answer. south_water's own numbers are byte-identical above and below the re-write.
